SELECT w.status, COUNT(DISTINCT w.web_order_id) orders, COUNT(f.sales_line_id) lines, MIN(w.order_ts_utc) mn, MAX(w.order_ts_utc) mx
FROM fact_web_order w LEFT JOIN fact_sales_line f ON f.receipt_id=w.web_order_id
WHERE w.order_ts_utc BETWEEN TIMESTAMP '2025-11-15' AND TIMESTAMP '2025-12-15'
GROUP BY 1

SELECT COUNT(*) n, COUNT(DISTINCT sales_line_id) ids, COUNT(DISTINCT (receipt_id, line_no)) rl, COUNT(DISTINCT etl_loaded_at) loads, MIN(etl_loaded_at) a, MAX(etl_loaded_at) b
FROM fact_sales_line WHERE sale_date BETWEEN DATE '2025-11-10' AND DATE '2025-12-14'

WITH params AS (SELECT 15 AS campaign_id),
campaign AS (
    SELECT c.campaign_id, c.campaign_name, c.start_date, c.end_date + 7 AS window_end
    FROM dim_campaign c JOIN params ON params.campaign_id = c.campaign_id
),
targeted AS (
    SELECT DISTINCT m.member_id
    FROM fact_campaign_exposure e
    JOIN dim_member m ON m.member_key = e.member_key
    JOIN params ON params.campaign_id = e.campaign_id
),
holdout AS (
    SELECT DISTINCT h.member_id FROM campaign_holdout h JOIN params ON params.campaign_id = h.campaign_id
),
members AS (
    SELECT member_id, 'targeted' AS member_group FROM targeted
    UNION ALL
    SELECT member_id, 'holdout' FROM holdout
),
web_dispatch AS (
    SELECT web_order_id,
           CAST(timezone('Europe/Helsinki', dispatch_ts_utc AT TIME ZONE 'UTC') AS DATE) AS dispatch_date
    FROM fact_web_order WHERE status IN ('delivered', 'collected')
),
member_sales AS (
    SELECT m.member_id, SUM(f.net_amount) AS net_sales
    FROM fact_sales_line f
    JOIN dim_member m  ON m.member_key = f.member_key
    JOIN dim_store s   ON s.store_key = f.store_key
    JOIN dim_product p ON p.product_key = f.product_key
    LEFT JOIN web_dispatch w ON w.web_order_id = f.receipt_id
    CROSS JOIN campaign
    WHERE s.store_id <> 999 AND p.category <> 'ZZ Test'
      AND COALESCE(w.dispatch_date, f.sale_date) BETWEEN campaign.start_date AND campaign.window_end
    GROUP BY 1
),
by_group AS (
    SELECT mb.member_group, COUNT(*) AS members, SUM(COALESCE(ms.net_sales,0)) tot, AVG(COALESCE(ms.net_sales, 0)) AS mean_net_sales, COUNT(ms.member_id) buyers
    FROM members mb LEFT JOIN member_sales ms ON ms.member_id = mb.member_id
    GROUP BY 1
)
SELECT * FROM by_group

calls.statement:
WITH campaign AS (
    SELECT campaign_id, campaign_name, start_date, end_date + 7 AS window_end FROM dim_campaign WHERE campaign_id = 15
),
targeted AS (
    SELECT DISTINCT m.member_id FROM fact_campaign_exposure e JOIN dim_member m ON m.member_key = e.member_key WHERE e.campaign_id = 15
),
holdout AS (SELECT DISTINCT member_id FROM campaign_holdout WHERE campaign_id = 15),
members AS (
    SELECT member_id, 'targeted' AS member_group FROM targeted
    UNION ALL SELECT member_id, 'holdout' FROM holdout
),
web_dispatch AS (
    SELECT web_order_id, CAST(timezone('Europe/Helsinki', dispatch_ts_utc AT TIME ZONE 'UTC') AS DATE) AS dispatch_date
    FROM fact_web_order WHERE status IN ('delivered', 'collected')
),
member_sales AS (
    SELECT m.member_id, SUM(f.net_amount) AS net_sales
    FROM fact_sales_line f
    JOIN dim_member m ON m.member_key = f.member_key
    JOIN dim_store s ON s.store_key = f.store_key
    JOIN dim_product p ON p.product_key = f.product_key
    LEFT JOIN web_dispatch w ON w.web_order_id = f.receipt_id
    CROSS JOIN campaign
    WHERE s.store_id <> 999 AND p.category <> 'ZZ Test'
      AND COALESCE(w.dispatch_date, f.sale_date) BETWEEN campaign.start_date AND campaign.window_end
    GROUP BY 1
),
by_group AS (
    SELECT mb.member_group, AVG(COALESCE(ms.net_sales, 0)) AS mean_net_sales
    FROM members mb LEFT JOIN member_sales ms ON ms.member_id = mb.member_id GROUP BY 1
)
SELECT 15 AS campaign_id, 'Black Week 2025' AS campaign_name,
  ROUND(MAX(CASE WHEN member_group='targeted' THEN mean_net_sales END), 2) AS avg_spend_targeted_eur,
  ROUND(MAX(CASE WHEN member_group='holdout' THEN mean_net_sales END), 2) AS avg_spend_holdout_eur,
  ROUND(MAX(CASE WHEN member_group='targeted' THEN mean_net_sales END) - MAX(CASE WHEN member_group='holdout' THEN mean_net_sales END), 2) AS uplift_eur
FROM by_group
